market_context: U.S. equities are sharply higher after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, reviving the AI trade after a correction, with SPY +4.6%, DIA +2.6% and NVDA +34.7% by 10:00 ET (finance.yahoo.com, cnbc.com). Volatility remains elevated and wholesale inflation data is due, so the rally may consolidate rather than continue vertically (finance.yahoo.com).

predictions.reasoning: SPY has recovered to $721.73 from its $713.54 intraday low after the Nvidia CEO news and a seven-day S&P decline, indicating dip buying ([finance.yahoo.com, finance.yahoo.com). Elevated VIX and the 4.95% 10-year yield argue against chasing a large further gain, but a modest grind into the close is plausible.

The Dow-linked ETF is up 2.6% and less extended than the Nasdaq after the Dow's worst week since 2020, with the rebound driven by Nvidia and broad risk appetite (finance.yahoo.com, cnbc.com). A small positive close from the 10:00 level is more likely than a full fade because cyclicals can participate even if tech consolidates.

Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO effective immediately, and President Trump publicly supported the move, sending NVDA up 34.7% and near its intraday high (finance.yahoo.com, cnbc.com). Sympathy gains in AI names and short-covering could keep the stock bid into the close, though profit-taking caps confidence.
